intent: Regenerate existing mini-game covers as square compositions using their original artwork as edit references.
postprocess: Lanczos resize and WebP encoding only; no painting or semantic image editing outside ImageGen.

stages.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / stylized-concept.
Asset type: final square cover art for an existing Russian driving theory mini-game, full-bleed square 1024x1024.
Input image 1 is the existing EDIT TARGET. Recompose this artwork into a SQUARE rather than cropping it. Preserve the same recognizable low-poly 3D style, sunny warm palette, clean modern Russian apartment parking lot, faceted green trees, parked small cars, bright blue sky. Preserve its focal concept: a beautiful thick red octagonal STOP road sign with exact white uppercase text "STOP", with a chunky red left-pointing arrow and a chunky bright green right-pointing arrow beneath it.
Composition: ALL of the complete red octagon including outer rim must fit between x=24%-76% and y=16%-52%. Keep both complete arrows between x=15%-85% and y=50%-66%, leaving a small gap below the sign. Zoom the camera OUT and show more environment around these subjects. The sign and both arrows must be fully visible with ample space at their sides. Bottom 25% of the image must be natural uncluttered asphalt with subtle lighting for later UI overlay. These percentages describe an invisible safe area, do NOT draw a box, guide, frame or UI. The lower asphalt should continue naturally from the scene. 
Materials: crisp physically plausible smooth low-poly render, light beveled edges, high quality shadows, charming game art.
Constraints: true 1:1 image. Recreate rather than crop. Do not change the STOP text. No human figures. No captions, no extra text, no score, no interface elements, no gradients, no baked dark vignette, no rounded corners, no border, no watermark. Preserve the original scene's visual identity, do not add more signs.

Use case: identity-preserve
Asset type: square mobile mini-game card cover, final composition 1:1, 1024 x 1024
Primary request: Recompose the attached existing portrait cover into a carefully designed square image for the same Russian driving game. Regenerate the scene based closely on the reference, preserving its recognizable character, warm color palette and polished low-poly 3D look.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target and exact visual/style reference.
Scene/backdrop: the same clean modern Russian city avenue, warm cream and orange buildings, faceted green trees, clear blue sky, softly lit by warm sunlight, road and a small orange car in distance.
Subject: the same traffic officer in dark navy uniform and peaked cap with small silver badge, black sunglasses, white gloves and neon yellow reflective vest. He faces the viewer, raising his right arm straight up (on viewer's left), holding the same black and white striped traffic baton. Preserve that pose, uniform and sunglasses.
Composition/framing: Pull the camera substantially back so the officer is a smaller, well framed central midshot. The COMPLETE raised arm, hand AND ENTIRE baton must be visible, with generous empty blue sky above it. Put the whole important subject inside a centered safe area from x=12% to 88% and y=16% to 68%. Baton tip around y=16%, officer's cap around y=35%, vest centered around y=51%, belt around y=68%. No subject touches any image edge. Reserve the lower 25% as calm uncluttered asphalt for app title and score; do not paint text or interface there. Composition must still read clearly if a little height is cropped from top or bottom.
Lighting/mood: welcoming warm afternoon sunlight, natural soft shadows.
Style/medium: polished stylized low-poly 3D illustration EXACTLY matching the reference, faceted trees and simplified handsome human character.
Constraints: preserve the reference character and pose; keep uniform and vest colors; 1:1 square; no baked gradient, no vignette, no caption, no UI, no frame, no badge, no logo, no watermark. Do not crop the baton, hand, head or torso.
